WITH candidate_series AS (SELECT s.* FROM series_facts s WHERE (s.side_a_team_id = ?) AND (s.side_b_region_id = ?) AND (s.date >= ?) AND (s.date <= ?) UNION SELECT s.* FROM series_facts s WHERE (s.side_b_team_id = ?) AND (s.side_a_region_id = ?) AND (s.date >= ?) AND (s.date <= ?)), matched_series AS (SELECT s.id, s.played_at, s.date, s.tournament_id, t.name AS tournament_name, t.category, s.best_of, s.side_a_team_id, s.side_b_team_id, s.side_a_era_id, s.side_b_era_id, s.side_a_region_id, s.side_b_region_id, s.side_a_name, s.side_b_name, s.side_a_score, s.side_b_score, s.winner_team_id, CASE WHEN s.side_a_team_id = ? THEN s.side_a_team_id ELSE s.side_b_team_id END AS series_left_team_id FROM candidate_series s CROSS JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = s.tournament_id WHERE (((s.side_a_team_id = ? AND s.side_b_region_id = ?) OR (s.side_b_team_id = ? AND s.side_a_region_id = ?))) AND (s.date >= ?) AND (s.date <= ?) AND (t.category IN (?)) AND (s.best_of IN (?))), direct_games AS (SELECT g.id, g.series_id, g.played_at, g.winner_team_id,
      CASE WHEN g.side_a_team_id = ? THEN g.side_a_team_id ELSE g.side_b_team_id END AS left_team_id
      FROM matched_series ms CROSS JOIN game_facts g ON g.series_id = ms.id
      WHERE ((g.side_a_team_id = ? AND g.side_b_region_id = ?) OR (g.side_b_team_id = ? AND g.side_a_region_id = ?))),
      
      oriented_matches AS (
        SELECT ms.*,
          ms.series_left_team_id AS left_team_id
        FROM matched_series ms
        
      )
     SELECT
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN winner_team_id = left_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS series_wins,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN winner_team_id <> left_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS series_losses,
       COUNT(*) AS series_total,
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN winner_team_id = left_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM direct_games) AS game_wins,
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN winner_team_id IS NOT NULL AND winner_team_id <> left_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM direct_games) AS game_losses,
       (SELECT COUNT(winner_team_id) FROM direct_games) AS game_total
     FROM oriented_matches

WITH candidate_games AS (SELECT DISTINCT game_id AS id FROM game_players WHERE player_entity_id = ?),
        candidate_series AS (SELECT DISTINCT g.series_id AS id FROM candidate_games cg
          CROSS JOIN game_facts g ON g.id = cg.id WHERE ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM game_players gp WHERE gp.game_id = g.id AND gp.side = ? AND gp.player_entity_id = ?) AND g.side_b_region_id = ?) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM game_players gp WHERE gp.game_id = g.id AND gp.side = ? AND gp.player_entity_id = ?) AND g.side_a_region_id = ?))), matched_series AS (SELECT s.id, s.played_at, s.date, s.tournament_id, t.name AS tournament_name, t.category, s.best_of, s.side_a_team_id, s.side_b_team_id, s.side_a_era_id, s.side_b_era_id, s.side_a_region_id, s.side_b_region_id, s.side_a_name, s.side_b_name, s.side_a_score, s.side_b_score, s.winner_team_id, NULL AS series_left_team_id FROM candidate_series cs CROSS JOIN series_facts s ON s.id = cs.id CROSS JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = s.tournament_id WHERE 1 = 1), direct_games AS (SELECT g.id, g.series_id, g.played_at, g.winner_team_id,
      CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM game_players gp WHERE gp.game_id = g.id AND gp.side = ? AND gp.player_entity_id = ?) THEN g.side_a_team_id ELSE g.side_b_team_id END AS left_team_id
      FROM matched_series ms CROSS JOIN game_facts g ON g.series_id = ms.id
      WHERE ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM game_players gp WHERE gp.game_id = g.id AND gp.side = ? AND gp.player_entity_id = ?) AND g.side_b_region_id = ?) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM game_players gp WHERE gp.game_id = g.id AND gp.side = ? AND gp.player_entity_id = ?) AND g.side_a_region_id = ?))),
      
      first_direct AS (
        SELECT current.id, current.series_id, current.left_team_id
        FROM direct_games current
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM direct_games earlier
          WHERE earlier.series_id = current.series_id
            AND (earlier.played_at < current.played_at

        SELECT ms.*,
          fd.left_team_id AS left_team_id
        FROM matched_series ms
        LEFT JOIN first_direct fd ON fd.series_id = ms.id

       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN winner_team_id = left_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS series_wins,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN winner_team_id <> left_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS series_losses,
